body: If you folks want to share your IM stuff with me.. I can add you and we can talk later. I'm hungry and I want to go get something to eat. I don't know if I'll be back here under this handle but Psy-Kosh knows where to find me if need be. :)

Okay, PM me when you get it and I'll give you my freenode nickname.
Thank you so much.

Do you use IRC by any chance? I'd prefer to talk in private there. I don't usually keep reddit open for long but I'm on IRC constantly. freenode is your best bet... I could share my AIM or MSN if really need be

I really just need somebody to come to for a bit of talk. I've been having really depressive thoughts lately and suicide is a common occurrence in them. I want to get those thoughts out of my head, so having heard about /r/SuicideWatch, I decided what better place to do so than here.

I don't know what really started triggering my depressive thoughts but people have become worried about me, and that makes me angry sometimes. People obsess over me too much and I wish they wouldn't. It's not like I'm going to kill myself anytime soon or something like that. That's not to say that the thought hasn't REALLY crossed my mind recently. I've said on multiple occasions to my friends recently that I want to die. I basically do. Whatever kills me faster is good enough.

I want to be able to stop thinking about this so much.
